rows.en:
Hold it!

In an incident like this, one that concerns the fate of the whole Earth, General HQ in Paris is the one that gives the orders! We can't act on our own!
But, Cap…
Both of you, calm down!
Hayata…

…!?

Hey, they're heading our way!
The saucers are coming to Japan!?
This is the Special Forces Unit… We've acquired the targets!!
What!?
Kelbaan…!?

What did you say!?

What about Kelbaan?
It's a huge formation! There are too many to count…
A huge formation…

Cap! An order from Paris HQ. I'll read it…

"The saucer fleet has been identified as Kelbaan, of the battle-fleet nation Naager.

It is believed they will attack other nations after destroying the Japan branch of the Science Patrol and Ultraman… We pray for the Japan branch's success!"

End of message!

Just as Ide said a moment ago, our defeat will mean defeat for the whole Earth.

I want you to fight with the life of the Japan branch on the line! Fuji, stay at HQ as our liaison!

Just as Ide said a moment ago, our defeat will mean defeat for the whole Earth.

I want you to fight with the life of the Japan branch on the line!

Ide, stand by at the TDF Science Center with Dr. Iwamoto! Fuji, stay at HQ as our liaison!
All right, move out!!
Ah… Oh no!? I meant to have them take the new weapon I finished yesterday!
I think you can still catch them.
Right!
Waaaagh…

Ah…!?

That's Bemular!?
Red King… and that's Dodongo!!
Red King… and that's Dodongo!?
But… weren't these things all beaten by Ultraman?
That's right… What on earth is going on?
It's like… we've wandered into the Kaiju Graveyard, isn't it?
Cap! Gigant's shown up too!
Fuji! Request a sortie from the Amigo Squad too! Hurry!
More of them showed up again! What the hell is going to happen to Earth?
Roger!

Oh, Doctor…?

Did you make it in time to explain the new weapon? If you like, why not contact them by radio?

Doctor…? Is something wrong?
Agh… Uuugh…
Here they come! The saucer fleet we've been hearing about.
Cap! It's another kaiju!

…!?

It can't be… Is that Seamons?
Seamons…?
Yeah… That's Seamons, no doubt about it! The legendary kaiju has appeared.

…!?

How many of them are there?
Damn… They mean to flaunt their strength at us! Just how powerful Naager's forces are…
Nurekuuha hiumo kenakena Seamons, yoodosa haukoomu meuraa Seamons…
What? What's that song?

Well… I don't really understand it either.

But… when I'm at the shop, Mr. Tachibana starts singing it every so often.
Oyassan does…?

Seamons is the guardian god of the island…

Seamons is a gentle-hearted kaiju. But when Seamons crosses the sea, beware… Something terrible will happen.
When it crosses the sea… something terrible will happen?
That's supposedly what the song means…

…Whoa whoa!?

There's a crazy number of them…
Damn… Do they mean to flaunt their strength at us? Just how powerful Naager's forces are…
Whoa, whoa… What's that all of a sudden…?

Yeah… I don't really get it either.

But… when I'm at the shop, Mr. Tachibana starts singing it every so often.

Seamons is the guardian god of the island…

Seamons is a gentle-hearted kaiju. But when Seamons crosses the sea, beware… Something terrible will happen, it says!
That's what the song means…
Cap! We can't reach HQ! Has something happened?

What!?

Fuji, Fuji… This is Muramatsu! HQ, respond! Fuji! Respond!

Hmm… We really can't get through, can we? All right, Arashi and Ide, go back to HQ and investigate!

Roger!

Fuji… What could have happened?
Cap! We can't reach HQ! Has something happened?

What!?

Fuji, Fuji… This is Muramatsu! HQ, respond! Fuji! Respond!

Hmm… We really can't get through, can we? All right, Arashi, go back to HQ and investigate!
Roger!

Geez, honestly… Dr. Iwamoto sure is late.

We promised to head back to the Science Center together… What's going on?
Hey, Ide!
Arashi… What's up? Got scared of the saucers and came running back?
Don't be stupid! We lost contact with HQ, so I got worried and came to check!
Fuji… What could have happened?

…!?

Hey, Fuji! What happened? Pull yourself together!
Fuji! Hang in there! Fuji!
Ugh… The culprit… is Dr. Iwamoto…
What!?
Dr. Iwamoto?
Whoa… It's dangerous here! Let's get out!
Come on, hang in there…
This is terrible…
Where did Fuji and Arashi and the others go?
Mm…

This is Muramatsu…

Arashi! Where are you?
Cap…

Ah…

Dr. Iwamoto!? Doctor!
Arashi! What's wrong? What happened?
Cap! Something's wrong with Dr. Iwamoto. He ran off over there!

uncertain: フジ隊員/アラシ隊員 rendered as bare "Fuji"/"Arashi" inside the Science Patrol (rank suffix dropped, as for -san).
U06349: quoted order put in "double quotes". 戦闘船団国家ナガー rendered "the battle-fleet nation Naager".
U06378: Seamons song is nonsense lyrics; romanized as written.
U06380/U06388: 立花さん from [HERO4] rendered "Mr. Tachibana" (she is not a Rider, so not "Oyassan").
U06357/U06412/U06414: narration-kind rows are continuations of the previous speaker's line; translated as such.
U06416: Iwamoto referred to as "He" (established male scientist).
